project.name: Numou Observability - Aggregator
project.description:
Phase 1 observability (Docs/Plan/base01.md §17, §P1-19): logging, tracing, metrics and health.
The one artifact every module needs from day one is the common telemetry context - traceId, spanId, correlationId, causationId, tenantId, participantId, userId, requestId - so a single operation can be reconstructed end to end:
API request -> domain transaction -> domain event -> outbox publish -> audit -> external webhook
Concrete exporters (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, ...) live behind ports and stay replaceable.
